x: Some of the foregoing have already shown they have ability, and good fellowship, and by now are well established Belgrave Harriers. We would single out for a special welcome, Knut Moe, a Norwegian visitor, who will be with us only for a few months.
Knut Moe, our Norwegian member, according to rumour from a neutral source, has made his getaway to England.

We even had a Finnish Javelin thrower, Saariaiho and from Norway a useful two lap man Knut Moe. Distance men too carried our colours, two Cypriots, Chris Worsley and a chap named Kyriakides slogged it out over the few marathons that were held in those days.
Knut Moe our Norwegian member, according to rumour from a neutral source, has escaped to England. Les Bennett is still amongst the missing in Malaya.
